excerpt: Propane collects customer feedback and context from 300+ tools into one shared canvas for product teams, then hands specs to coding and design agents.
content:
Propane is a customer-intelligence tool for product teams. It pulls in what customers and competitors tell you from more than 300 tools, including support conversations, CRM notes, sales calls, meeting transcripts, Slack threads, issues, product analytics and billing and churn signals, and keeps one up-to-date view of each customer. Teams then shape ideas together on a shared canvas with the evidence attached, and can push the result straight to coding or design agents.

Pricing is a flat €50 a month for the whole platform with unlimited users, plus a usage charge for each company or competitor you index with new context that month. The first 100 companies and first 5 competitors each month are free.

Propane's makers on Product Hunt include founder Dennis Green-Lieber and co-founder John Acosta. Dennis says the founding team has built products for more than ten years at SaaS and deep-learning AI companies. Propane launched on Product Hunt on 24 June 2026, hunted by Ben Lang, and finished #2 for the day with 500 upvotes and 170 comments. It has 2 Product Hunt reviews averaging 5 out of 5 (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested Propane ourselves. This page brings together its official site and pricing page, its Product Hunt launch and the public pricing pages of comparable tools, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: One always-current view of your customers for product teams and their agents

paragraphs: Dennis Green-Lieber says the founding team has built products for more than ten years at SaaS and deep-learning AI companies, and built Propane to fix their own problems: the way product teams work has hardly changed in years.

After going deep with hundreds of product teams, he says they found two camps, those stuck in legacy tools and those building everything from scratch, both doing 90% of the same work: collecting customer feedback, shaping and judging ideas, and handing off to coding agents.
launch_story.attribution: Dennis Green-Lieber, founder, on Product Hunt

use_cases: Bringing feedback from support, sales calls, CRM and Slack into one view per customer
Tracking what competitors are doing alongside customer requests
Planning features on a shared canvas with the evidence attached
Handing a finished spec to a coding or design agent

fit: run a product team whose customer feedback is scattered across many tools
want the whole company in the tool without paying per seat
already build with coding agents and want them to see customer context
not_fit: track thousands of accounts with frequent new context: the per-company charge adds up (the pricing page's example team of 20 pays €450 a month)
only need a simple feedback board or survey tool

pricing.intro: Propane has one plan with everything included, plus a usage charge for new context. Prices are in euros.

plans.name: Platform
plans.detail: Unlimited users, every feature, unlimited integrations, free hands-on onboarding; no credit card to sign up

plans.name: Usage: companies
plans.price: €1 per company indexed with new context that month

plans.name: Usage: competitors
plans.price: €10 per competitor indexed with new context that month

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Migration and historical ingestion, custom integrations, SSO, invoice or PO billing, volume pricing

notes: No per-seat, token, storage or model-upgrade fees, according to the pricing page. A company is charged once a month however often its context updates; if nothing changes, nothing is charged.

alternatives.intro: Tools that also gather customer feedback for product teams. Prices are from each company's own pricing page on 14 October 2026.

items.name: Dovetail
items.what: Customer intelligence from calls, documents and surveys
items.difference: Strong on research analysis of calls and interviews; Propane adds a planning canvas and hand-off to coding agents.

items.name: Productboard
items.what: Product management platform for feedback, prioritisation and roadmaps
items.difference: A long-established roadmap and prioritisation tool; Propane is built around automatically collected context for agents.

liked: Multiplayer decision-making across product and other teams
Tackling how fragmented product work has become
asked: Where the line sits between automation and human product taste (the founder said vision and taste stay human; Propane supplies cleaner data)

quotes.text: Product work has become way too fragmented. How are you thinking about the line between automation and actual product taste?
quotes.author: Marie Saxon

quotes.text: The multiplayer part and how we can accelerate our decision making in Product and cross functionally is critical to get right
quotes.author: Michael Auchenberg

pros: Unlimited users on a flat base fee
No token, storage or feature-tier charges
Collects from 300+ tools and tracks competitors too
Hands work straight to coding and design agents
cons: Usage charges scale with the number of active customer accounts

quotes.author: Marie Saxon
quotes.text: How are you thinking about the line between automation and actual product taste?
quotes.reply: Dennis Green-Lieber said humans are best at vision, taste and deciding how to solve things, while data and sources are where Propane helps.

€50 a month for the full platform with unlimited users, plus €1 per company and €10 per competitor indexed with new context each month; the first 100 companies and 5 competitors are free.

faq.q: Which tools does Propane connect to?
faq.a: Its site mentions HubSpot, Intercom and Slack among 300+ integrations covering support, CRM, calls, analytics, issues and billing.
